extDescription.message: A modern Lichess: a roomy layout, playful pages, your own board, pieces and sounds, and a Game Review for every game.
extDescription.description: The extension's summary, shown in chrome://extensions and on the Chrome Web Store (132 characters at most).

sidebarCollapse.description: The sidebar's toggle, while it shows its labels.

sidebarExpand.description: The sidebar's toggle, while it shows only its icons.

puzzleMenu.description: The puzzle page's cog, which opens the puzzle's details, its theme and the settings.

settingsLink.description: The account menu's link to the extension's settings.

settingsTitle.description: The title of the extension's settings, on the account page.

settingsIntro.message: The extension's settings. They follow you to every browser you sync with your Google account.
settingsIntro.description: Under the title of the extension's settings.

settingUiSounds.description: The setting that turns the extension's interface sounds on and off.

settingUiSoundsBody.message: Little sounds as you use the extension's controls, like the notches of Stockfish's level slider. Lichess's sounds and your pack's don't change.
settingUiSoundsBody.description: What the interface sounds setting covers.

packsTitle.description: The title of the settings' card for the imported packs.

packsBody.message: Your own board, pieces or sounds, from a pack on GitHub. Once imported, pick them in the user menu, in the Extension tab of Board, Piece set or Sound.
packsBody.description: What the packs card is for.

packsEmpty.description: The packs card, before any import.

packsUnreadable.message: The imported packs could not be read.
packsUnreadable.description: The packs card, when the browser's storage fails.

packsPartPieces.description: A pack holds a piece set.

packsRemove.description: The button that removes an imported pack.

packsLink.message: Link to a pack on GitHub
packsLink.description: The placeholder of the field for a pack's link.

packsImport.description: The button that imports a pack.

packsPrivate.description: Opens the field for a private repository's token.

packsToken.description: The placeholder of the token's field.

packsTokenNote.message: A fine-grained token that can only read this repository’s contents, used for this import and never kept.

packsImported.description: Once a pack is imported; $1 is its name.

packsImportFailed.message: The pack could not be imported.
packsImportFailed.description: An import that failed for an unknown reason.

packsNoLink.message: Paste a link to a pack first.
packsNoLink.description: Import pressed with an empty link.

packsHelp.description: The link to the pack format's guide.
